actualComparison: Viewed actual PNG against native R06 and supplied reference.
improved: Occluded timber and column lacquer have more coherent actual indirect illumination.
Gold highlight gradients and light admitted through real apertures feel more natural than the native room-cube approximation.
Room reflection and sun shafts come from actual geometry/ray transport rather than native screen-space hooks.
remaining: Floor mirror reflection is substantially weaker than the reference/native calibrated custom varnish.
Denoised fine ornaments are soft at128samples; actual carved patterns/coffers/flowers/anatomy remain unlike reference.
R06 lotus black gaps and flat leaf crown remained visible; the subsequent R07 geometry addresses them and is not represented by this physical image.
rendererDifference: Native floor-varnish.js replaces clearcoatSpecularIndirect by a custom capture-sampled radiance blend at .96. That GLSL hook is not exported. Cycles uses actual Principled clearcoat and source albedo/roughness instead; .17 coat roughness/.72 coat weight were retained. Weak physical reflection is therefore an actual calibration limitation, not native pixel parity.
futureCalibrationNotApplied: A future physical-gloss calibration requires actual re-rendering with source-bound reflective clearcoat/albedo choices after geometry acceptance; no image editing or automatic film replacement was performed.
